relTest.notes: Report check: a must-cover list for each kind of report (shingle, tile, metal, roof, plumbing, ground collapse, flooring, tree fall, lightning; add your own items). A quick look before making the Word report. Remember where a detail comes from (a project box or an interview question) for every report. Excel import shows what goes where first. Company profile: business number and the engineer who reviews and signs, with a choice for the signature space; reports fill them where your template has them. Templates: change wording in all of them at once; one report is enough to learn the details.
